description: This file defines the LogNormal class which provides statistical distribution functions related to the lognormal distribution, including cumulative distribution, probability density function, and inverse functions. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation engine.

classes.name: LogNormal
classes.description: Provides methods for calculating the lognormal distribution functions such as the cumulative distribution, density, and inverse functions.

methods.name: cumulative
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative lognormal distribution function for a given value, mean, and standard deviation.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the lognormal distribution's probability density function or cumulative distribution function based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the lognormal cumulative distribution function (quantile function) for a given probability, mean, and standard deviation.
